description: Deterministic release-gate contract for the PetTripFinder Greater St. Louis market (bi-state MO/IL). Structure follows the live-market precedent; every value is re-derived from this market's own committed artifacts and none is copied.
status_note: Live: this contract gates the assembly of a PUBLISHED market. It grants no deployment -- publication is a state of the source and deployment is a separate act recorded in deploy/netlify/deployment_authorizations/.

deployment_authorization.means: A passing contract means this market's assembled package is STRUCTURALLY deployable: its authority files agree, its routes match its reviewed inventory, no held or superseded identity leaks and every gate holds. It is not a deployment authorization, and PTF-ST-LOUIS-REGISTER-PUBLISH-011 deployed nothing.

provenance.superseded_note: Two census identities turned out to be one building each. The founder SUPERSEDED the duplicate signatures rather than deleting them: both original attestations remain readable in the ledgers that recorded them, and the current authority is the union of signed rows minus the withdrawn ones.
held_identities: days inn and suites pontoon beach
provenance.held_note: Held because only ONE strong identity signal agrees and the second contradicts it: the street matches exactly and the telephone does not. The founder rule requires two AGREEING signals and does not permit one agreement plus one contradiction.

identity_census.note: The 357-identity census was built by PTF-ST-LOUIS-MARKET-001 on the generic discovery path from Google Places and OpenStreetMap over 18 bounded cells. It carries no policy annotation this contract relies on: every no-pets record here reached the exclusion set through an explicit founder decision, never off a census field.

reconciliation.note: verified_no_pets counts ONLY VERIFIED_NO_PETS records this market owns. unresolved is UNKNOWN and never negative evidence: 153 identities were never reached by a lane that could answer, 66 hold insufficient evidence, 16 served a page that stated nothing, and 1 is held on an unsettled identity. A failed capture answers nothing.

policy_package.note: The verified hotel identities are DERIVED from this package at assembly time via scripts.pettripfinder.site_data.verified_public_hotels(); they are not restated here. This market's package carries published: true and a publication block naming the work order that flipped it -- publication is a state of the package, not a property of any record, and the records are byte-identical to the ones the founder approved.
policy_package.schema_version_note: 1.3, not 1.2. PTF-ST-LOUIS-PUBLICATION-SCHEMA-DECISIONS-010 made two ADDITIVE amendments under founder decision: an optional service_animal_statement.quote, so a verified service-animal statement can carry the property's exact words; and an optional other_charges[].refundable_stated, so a charge can record that the source did not state refundability instead of forcing a writer to invent one. Every 1.2 record remains valid and no live market needs migrating: 1.2 and 1.3 are both CANONICAL schema versions, and the compatibility reader's legacy set (1.0, 1.1) was deliberately not widened -- that reader parses facts as display strings and would empty every canonical fee.
policy_package.founder_normalisation_note: 48 records carry weight_limit.operator=lte and scope=per_pet under founder decision 1, which authorises that projection ONLY where a property-specific source states an unqualified blanket maximum, no combined-weight language appears, no conflicting per-room total exists and no contrary scope is stated. Each such record preserves its source text and records the normalisation. This is a PUBLICATION rule and does not license the extraction reader to invent operator or scope.
policy_package.structured_pricing_note: 4 records price by stay length and carry fee_tiers rather than a single pet_fee: the ladder IS the price and no single amount is asserted for them. 6 carry a fee_cap with qualifier_stated=false, which means the source states the cap and states no further qualifier -- NOT that no qualifier exists. 5 carry a pet deposit in other_charges, distinct from any pet fee; 3 of those declare refundable_stated=false because the source never said whether the deposit returns.
policy_package.service_animal_note: 41 records carry service_animal_statement on the RECORD ENVELOPE, never inside facts. policy_schema.validate_record has always rejected facts.service_animal_exception as MISPLACED_FIELD -- a legal access category must not sit in the commercial-terms namespace, because a weight limit beside it invites something to apply one to the other. That is the founder's own Decision 2 constraint, already enforced by the contract. charges_stated is read from the service-animal sentence itself and is only ever no_charge (31) or not_addressed (10); charge_stated is unreachable by projection.
policy_package.record_contract_note: All 82 records pass contracts.policy_schema.validate_record and the package passes validate_package, not merely validate_facts. 010's first draft validated fact blocks only and emitted no identity_key, so every record would have failed the record contract that all five live markets satisfy.
policy_package.sha_note: The sha256 of the package in its PUBLISHED state, which is deterministic: publication adds published: true, a note and a publication block dated from the founder's decision rather than from the clock, so the file a rebuild produces is the file this hash covers.
policy_package.identity_key_note: A record's ``key`` is the DISPLAY join key -- normalize_name of the name the record publishes -- and its ``identity_key`` is the census identity the founder signed against. They coincide on 78 of the 82 records and differ on the four whose census name was a bare chain word that an evidence-cited correction replaced. Publishing the bare word instead was not available: 'holiday inn express and suites' is ALREADY a live Cleveland identity, and one identity is one listing.
policy_package.withheld_fields_note: 8 withholding decisions across 4 records, every one SCHEMA_CANNOT_REPRESENT: the surface states charge components the fee vocabulary cannot carry together, so no single pet fee is asserted. Each carries the reader's own sentence and the evidence references to re-adjudicate it against. 22 SOURCE_SILENT entries the signed authority carried were DROPPED rather than published: contracts.withholding rejects SOURCE_SILENT by name -- genuine silence is the ABSENCE of a field, and an entry claiming a decision was made about a non-event would tell a reader the hotel was overruled when it simply never spoke.

public_surface.held_hotel_exclusion: Every seed hotel this market owns that is absent from the committed package must have NO public route and NO reference on any surface: hotel profiles, the hotels listing page, nearby-lodging cards, the policy-comparison table, the sitemap, canonicals, internal links and /go/ interstitials. This market's seed inventory is derived one row per approved record, so a held, refused or SUPERSEDED property has no inventory row to leak -- and the gate is derived, so it starts enforcing the moment that changes.

routes.note: route_mode market_prefixed: this market's hub, corridor and policy-comparison pages live under /pet-friendly-hotels/st-louis-mo/. Fifteen of its sixteen configured corridors reach their own configured minimum and claim a route; the rest claim none. The market and its corridors stay hidden from navigation and the sitemap (show_in_navigation=false, show_in_sitemap=false), matching the posture the market contract carries and the one Pittsburgh launched with.

publish.note: The publish root must contain ONLY the static website plus the two Netlify control files. Build-internal reports the generator emits (_build_report.json, _broken_link_report.json, _quality_report.json, bundle_manifest.json) are read for gating but are excluded from site/ and must never ship.

identity_confirmations.discriminator: different Marriott property codes stlff and stlsu; a shared switchboard is ordinary at a dual-brand property
identity_confirmations.note: The two rows carry OPPOSITE pet findings -- one pet-friendly, one verified-no-pets -- which is only coherent if they are two hotels. This confirmation exists so the same-address gate does not have to re-ask.
